items.prompt: Choose the correct verb: I ___ at seven and have breakfast.
items.explanation: 'Wake up' starts the day; breakfast comes after.

items.prompt: Choose the correct verb: She ___ to school on foot.
items.explanation: Third person of 'go' is 'goes': She goes to school.

items.prompt: Write two words: I ___ ___ at eleven because I am tired.
items.explanation: 'Go to bed' describes ending the day.

items.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: I have lunch ___ one o'clock.
items.explanation: Clock times take 'at': at one o'clock.

items.prompt: Write one word: We watch a film ___ the evening.
items.explanation: Parts of the day take 'in': in the evening.

options: I always drink tea in the morning.
I drink always tea in the morning.
Always I drink tea in the morning.
I drink tea in the morning always.
items.explanation: Frequency adverbs go before the main verb.

items.prompt: Write two words: He ___ ___ eats meat; he is vegetarian.
items.explanation: 'Never' goes before the verb: He never eats meat.
